content:
No per-user API rate-limiting middleware exists in this codebase.

I checked both structurally and textually: `[ArchMap query]` returned a certified miss across all 7293 indexed symbols (exact, prefix, substring, and doc-text tiers), `[ArchMap query]` lists all 81 registered HTTP routes/middleware wiring with no rate-limit interceptor among them, and a grep for `RateLimit`/`throttle`/`limiter`/`429` across the whole repo found no matches in application code — the only hit is a comment in `internal/email/README.md:292` documenting an *email-sending* rate limiter (`rate.NewLimiter(rate.Every(time.Second), 10)`, 10/sec), which is unrelated to API request handling.

So the premise is incorrect: there's no per-user API rate-limiting middleware registered anywhere in this repo (`memos`), and consequently no request limits to report for one.
